integrity: Analytic identity established by counting mutually compatible prescribed pairing witnesses; standard-library verifier checks exact finite examples. The unrestricted assertion does not rely on finite enumeration. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to uniformly paired labeled half-edges; no conditioning on graph simplicity or connectedness. Its arbitrary-degree identity does not classify irregular-profile signs. The regular sign split is proved for total degree at least six, with the four-half-edge exception explicit. The literature comparison is not independent publication-priority certification.
source_ids: Wormald 1999: Models of Random Regular Graphs
title: A finite-size sign reversal between loops and parallel-edge pairs in random configurations
